requirements.transport: ESP-IDF Security2 SRP6a + AES-256-GCM; HTTPD transport isolated from Arduino legacy port-80 server
requirements.code: fresh six-digit CSPRNG PIN displayed on Waveshare only; never transmitted in clear HTTP
requirements.salt_verifier: device-generated ephemeral salt and SRP verifier, destroyed after pairing window
requirements.peer_identity: long-lived pinned device key plus cryptographic HA peer key possession proof
requirements.pairing_confirmation: fresh touchscreen approval of the exact HA peer fingerprint
requirements.attempt_limit: persistently limited to five candidates, with power-cycle resistant lockout
requirements.reinstall: fresh pairing required, device configuration preserved
requirements.deployment: separately authorized by HA administrator plus fresh touchscreen approval; disabled

notes: This preview response is intentionally not a secure pairing endpoint; a successful GET cannot authorize any write, token or paired state.
